name: baron-pit-drmundo-1v1
description: Baron Pit Dr. Mundo 1v1 Dodgeball in the Browser with Authentic League of Legends 3D Graphics & Animations

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:config
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.start:rust: npm run build:client && npm run build:config && npm run build:rust && ./server-rs/target/release/baron-pit-server
scripts.test:rust: cd server-rs && cargo test && cargo build --release && cd .. && TEST_SERVER_CMD=./server-rs/target/release/baron-pit-server node --test dist-test/tests/server_ws.test.js
